title: 꼭대기 층
suno_analysis_sp: K-Rock track featuring distorted electric guitars, driving acoustic drums, and a male vocal lead. The arrangement centers on a syncopated guitar riff using power chords and palm muting. The bass guitar follows the kick drum pattern with a gritty, overdriven tone. The drums utilize a standard rock kit with heavy emphasis on the crash cymbals during transitions and a consistent eighth-note hi-hat pattern. The vocal delivery is melodic but aggressive, shifting into a higher register for the chorus. Key of E Major, 145 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff, palm-muted power chords]
[drums enter with snare roll and crash cymbal]

[Verse 1]
[male vocals]
튕기는 심장이야
나는 아직 여기야
엘리베이터 앞에서 [bass guitar enters]
층수가 달라져

[Verse 2]
같이 입사했잖아
같은 출발선이었는데
누가 빠르냐가 실력은 아닌 걸 알아

[Chorus]
[full band energy increases, open hi-hats]
내 속도가 있어
남에게 나를 띄지 마
꼭대기 층 옥상에서
바람을 맞으며
빠른 것보다 [guitar lead flourish]
